description: Build the game on the Mac and push it to itch.io with butler. Pass --source . (your checkout; it's built on the Mac with the project's build command, sandboxed) or --build PATH (a finished build). Each branch goes to its own channel (CHANNEL-BRANCH, e.g. mac-new-jump), the main branch to CHANNEL; keep using the same branch so the itch app updates in place. butler only uploads what changed.

args.name: source
args.description: the repo checkout to build on the Mac (usually .); only files git keeps are sent

args.name: build
args.description: a finished build instead: a folder, a .zip, or a single executable

args.name: channel
args.description: channel to push to instead of the branch's

args.name: version
args.description: version label shown on itch (default: the commit)

settings.name: build_command
settings.description: run in the checkout on the Mac, sandboxed: no network, no access to your files

settings.name: build_output
settings.description: the folder the build command makes, which gets pushed

settings.name: main_branch
settings.description: branch that pushes to the base channel

settings.name: hide_new_channels
settings.description: yes: new branch channels are hidden from the game page
